name: Murderous Sniper (Mythic)
body:
You can deliver a killing strike from very long distances.

Prerequisite(s): Murderous Sniper.

Benefit(s): You can hit a target up to 60 feet of distance with a ranged death attack. For every additional round you spend studying the target, you can extend this range by 20 feet.
